properties.description: Triggers when critical runtime errors exceed threshold.

allOf.query: customEvents | extend eventName = case(isnotempty(tostring(name)), tostring(name), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"])), tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"]), tostring(customDimensions.eventType)) | where eventName in ('rag_error','realtime_connection_error','realtime_service_error','booking_provider_error','call_finalization_degraded','uncaught_exception','unhandled_rejection') | summarize errorCount = count()

properties.description: Triggers when P95 response latency breaches SLO.

allOf.query: customEvents | extend eventName = case(isnotempty(tostring(name)), tostring(name), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"])), tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"]), tostring(customDimensions.eventType)) | where eventName == 'response_latency' | extend latencyMs = coalesce(todouble(customDimensions.responseLatencyMs), todouble(customDimensions.latencyMs)) | where isnotnull(latencyMs) | summarize p95 = percentile(latencyMs, 95)

properties.description: Triggers when completed bookings from provider webhooks drop below target.

allOf.query: let VoiceBotEvents = customEvents | extend eventName = case(isnotempty(tostring(name)), tostring(name), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"])), tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"]), tostring(customDimensions.eventType)), callId = case(isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callId)), tostring(customDimensions.callId), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callSID)), tostring(customDimensions.callSID), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callSid)), tostring(customDimensions.callSid), tostring(customDimensions.sid)); let totalCalls = toscalar(VoiceBotEvents | where eventName == 'call_summary' and isnotempty(callId) | summarize dcount(callId)); let completedBookings = toscalar(VoiceBotEvents | where eventName in ('booking_completed_webhook','call_summary') and isnotempty(callId) | extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome), bookingCompleted = tobool(customDimensions.bookingCompleted) | where eventName == 'booking_completed_webhook' or outcome == 'booking_completed' or bookingCompleted | summarize dcount(callId)); print completionPct = iif(totalCalls == 0, 100.0, 100.0 * todouble(completedBookings) / todouble(totalCalls))

properties.description: Triggers when callers with booking intent are not reaching link delivery or completion stages.

allOf.query: let VoiceBotEvents = customEvents | extend eventName = case(isnotempty(tostring(name)), tostring(name), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"])), tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"]), tostring(customDimensions.eventType)), callId = case(isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callId)), tostring(customDimensions.callId), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callSID)), tostring(customDimensions.callSID), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callSid)), tostring(customDimensions.callSid), tostring(customDimensions.sid)); let intentCalls = toscalar(VoiceBotEvents | where eventName in ('booking_intent_detected','booking_link_requested','booking_link_delivery_sent','booking_link_sent') and isnotempty(callId) | summarize dcount(callId)); let deliveredCalls = toscalar(VoiceBotEvents | where eventName in ('booking_link_delivery_sent','booking_link_sent','booking_completed_webhook') and isnotempty(callId) | summarize dcount(callId)); print deliveryPct = iif(intentCalls == 0, 100.0, 100.0 * todouble(deliveredCalls) / todouble(intentCalls))

properties.description: Triggers when completed or cancelled booking webhooks cannot be attributed to a valid call.

allOf.query: customEvents | extend eventName = case(isnotempty(tostring(name)), tostring(name), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"])), tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"]), tostring(customDimensions.eventType)) | where eventName == 'booking_webhook_orphaned' | summarize orphanCount = count()

properties.description: Triggers when durable workflow action readiness reports dead-letter backlog.

allOf.query: customEvents | extend eventName = case(isnotempty(tostring(name)), tostring(name), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"])), tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"]), tostring(customDimensions.eventType)) | where eventName == 'workflow_readiness_checked' | extend deadLetterCount = coalesce(toint(customDimensions.deadLetterCount), 0) | summarize deadLetterCount = max(deadLetterCount)

properties.description: Triggers when durable workflow action readiness reports stale processing locks.

allOf.query: customEvents | extend eventName = case(isnotempty(tostring(name)), tostring(name), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"])), tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"]), tostring(customDimensions.eventType)) | where eventName == 'workflow_readiness_checked' | extend staleProcessingCount = coalesce(toint(customDimensions.staleProcessingCount), 0) | summarize staleProcessingCount = max(staleProcessingCount)

properties.description: Triggers when the durable workflow action outbox poller reports failures.

allOf.query: customEvents | extend eventName = case(isnotempty(tostring(name)), tostring(name), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"])), tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"]), tostring(customDimensions.eventType)) | where eventName == 'action_outbox_poll_failed' | summarize pollFailureCount = count()
